answer: Farming becomes a nadir bet on surviving 66 epochs of grading, and every violet settlement recomputes the ember schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 66 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
